import ctypes

# Allocate two chunks of memory
chunk1 = ctypes.create_string_buffer(b"Hello, World!")
chunk2 = ctypes.create_string_buffer(13)  # Size of "Hello, World!" is 13 bytes

# Copy the contents of the first chunk into the second chunk
ctypes.memmove(chunk2, chunk1, len(chunk1))

# Print the contents of the second chunk
print("Contents of chunk2 after copy:", chunk2.value.decode('utf-8'))

# Free the memory allocated to the first chunk
# Note: ctypes.create_string_buffer does not support direct free, so we simulate
# In practice, this would require using malloc/free from C, but we'll use a workaround
del chunk1

# Print the contents of the second chunk (still valid)
print("Contents of chunk2 after freeing chunk1:", chunk2.value.decode('utf-8'))

# Free the memory allocated to the second chunk
del chunk2

# Attempt to print the contents of the second chunk (undefined behavior, but we simulate)
try:
    print("Contents of chunk2 after freeing:", chunk2.value.decode('utf-8'))
except Exception as e:
    print("Error accessing freed memory:", str(e))

# Attempt to free the memory allocated to the second chunk again (double free)
try:
    del chunk2
except Exception as e:
    print("Error on double free:", str(e))

import ctypes

# Allocate two blocks of memory
block1_size = 10
block2_size = 10

block1 = ctypes.create_string_buffer(block1_size)
block2 = ctypes.create_string_buffer(block2_size)

# Initialize first block with some data
data = b"Hello, World!"
block1.value = data

# Copy content from first block to second block
ctypes.memmove(block2, block1, len(data))

# Print second block content
print("After copying:", block2.value.decode('utf-8'))

# Free memory allocated for first block
# Note: ctypes.create_string_buffer does not allow explicit free
# So we use raw memory allocation with ctypes
# Reallocate using raw memory for proper free
block1_raw = ctypes.pythonapi.PyMem_Malloc(block1_size)
block2_raw = ctypes.pythonapi.PyMem_Malloc(block2_size)

# Copy data to raw memory
ctypes.memmove(block1_raw, data, len(data))

# Copy from raw block1 to raw block2
ctypes.memmove(block2_raw, block1_raw, len(data))

# Print second block content
print("After copying (raw):", ctypes.string_at(block2_raw, len(data)).decode('utf-8'))

# Free memory allocated for first block
ctypes.pythonapi.PyMem_Free(block1_raw)

# Print second block content
print("After freeing block1:", ctypes.string_at(block2_raw, len(data)).decode('utf-8'))

# Free memory allocated for second block
ctypes.pythonapi.PyMem_Free(block2_raw)

# Print second block content
print("After freeing block2:", "Memory already freed, accessing it is undefined behavior.")

import ctypes

# Выделение двух фрагментов памяти
size = 10
ptr1 = ctypes.c_char_p(b'\x00' * size)
ptr2 = ctypes.c_char_p(b'\x00' * size)

# Копирование содержимого первого фрагмента во второй
data = b"Hello, World!"
ctypes.memmove(ptr2, data, len(data))

# Печать содержимого второго фрагмента
print(ptr2.value.decode('utf-8'))

# Освобождение памяти, выделенной для первого фрагмента
ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_char).from_address(id(ptr1)).contents = None

# Печать содержимого второго фрагмента
print(ptr2.value.decode('utf-8'))

# Освобождение памяти, выделенной для второго фрагмента
ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_char).from_address(id(ptr2)).contents = None

# Печать содержимого второго фрагмента (после освобождения)
print(ptr2.value.decode('utf-8'))
